unit_of_analysis: one frozen logical read-mutate-commit schedule; retries remain within that schedule

primary_endpoint.name: forbidden_commit_observed
primary_endpoint.definition: A transition committed only when the final observer proves the relevant governance mutation committed before transition admission began.
primary_endpoint.denominator_rule: Only executed, observer-complete frozen schedules enter a denominator; NOT_RUN, infrastructure error, missing audit, and indeterminate ordering remain separate categories.

schedule_analysis.TOCTOU-01: Report commit outcome and transition/audit counts after consent revoke.
schedule_analysis.TOCTOU-02: Report commit outcome and transition/audit counts after persisted role or purpose mutation.
schedule_analysis.TOCTOU-03: Classify only observer-proven ordering; overlapping commit/revoke windows are indeterminate, never safe.
schedule_analysis.TOCTOU-04: Report stale-policy snapshot replay outcome and transition/audit counts.
schedule_analysis.TOCTOU-05: Report concurrent writer/proposal ordering, commit outcome, and audit reconstruction separately.

secondary_outputs.latency: Report per-schedule descriptive latency in milliseconds; do not infer deployment throughput.
secondary_outputs.transaction_metadata: Record PostgreSQL version, isolation level, lock strategy, retries, schema/image hashes, and source revision.
secondary_outputs.audit: Report exact reconstruction status separately from commit outcome; an empty or hash-only audit observation is not completeness.

missing_data_rule: Missing work is NOT_RUN and is never encoded as zero forbidden commits or a successful schedule.
freeze_rule: This plan, the five-schedule manifest, ordered seeds, environment metadata, and observer contract are frozen before execution; any material change requires a new run ID.
result_status_rule: A final result is claim-eligible only when every scheduled execution is observer-complete. NOT_RUN, infrastructure error, missing audit, and indeterminate ordering remain explicit and are never recoded as safe.
